units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 8) establishment and maintenance of the municipal archive;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 9) organization of library services for the population and acquisition and preservation of the collections of municipal libraries;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 10) maintenance of burial grounds;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 11) assignment, change and cancellation of addresses of addressable objects; assignment, change and cancellation of names of elements of the street and road network (except roads of federal, regional or intermunicipal significance) and of elements of the planning structure within the municipality’s boundaries; and entry of information in the State Address Register;
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 12) approval of rules for improvement and upkeep of the municipality’s territory, and organization of such improvement and upkeep in accordance with those rules;
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 13) adoption of decisions and implementation of measures in the municipality to identify right holders of previously recorded real estate, and submission of information about those right holders for entry in the Unified State Register of Real Estate;
units.label: Point 13 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 14) ensuring performance of the work necessary to create artificial land plots for municipal needs in accordance with federal law;
units.label: Point 14 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 15) identification of sites of accumulated environmental damage and organization of remediation of that damage in territories located within the boundaries of municipally owned land plots;
units.label: Point 15 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 16) organization of collection of statistical indicators characterizing the state of the municipality’s economy and social sphere, and provision of those data to state authorities in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 16 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 17) recording in household registers the personal subsidiary farms operated by citizens in accordance with Federal Law of 07.07.2003 No. 112-ФЗ “On Personal Subsidiary Farming”;
units.label: Point 17 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 18) organization of professional education and supplementary professional education for persons holding municipal offices, municipal servants and employees of municipal enterprises and institutions, and organization of personnel training for municipal service in accordance with the procedure provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on education and on municipal service;
units.label: Point 18 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 19) development and implementation of measures to strengthen interethnic and interfaith harmony, support and develop the languages and cultures of the peoples of the Russian Federation residing in the municipality, realize the rights of indigenous small-numbered peoples and other national minorities, ensure migrants’ social and cultural adaptation, and prevent interethnic conflicts;
units.label: Point 19 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 20) creation of conditions for the development of local traditional folk artistic creativity, and participation in the preservation, revival and development of folk arts and crafts;
units.label: Point 20 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 21) ensuring basic fire safety measures within the municipality’s boundaries;
units.label: Point 21 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 22) creation of conditions for municipal residents to receive services from cultural organizations, for the organization of leisure and mass recreation for residents, and development of public recreation areas;
units.label: Point 22 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 23) preservation, use and promotion of municipally owned cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments), and protection of cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of local (municipal) significance located in the municipality;
units.label: Point 23 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 24) creation of conditions for the development of agricultural production and expansion of the market for agricultural products, raw materials and food;
units.label: Point 24 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 25) promotion of the development of small and medium-sized entrepreneurship;
units.label: Point 25 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 26) support for socially oriented nonprofit organizations, charitable activities and volunteering;
units.label: Point 26 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 27) support for scientific, scientific and technological, and innovation activities carried out in the municipality; adoption of programs and organization and conduct of municipal events aimed at popularizing science;
units.label: Point 27 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 28) organization and implementation of work with children and young people; participation in the implementation of youth policy; development and implementation of measures to ensure and protect young people’s rights and legitimate interests; development and implementation of municipal programs in the principal areas of youth policy implementation; and organization and conduct of monitoring of youth policy implementation in the municipality;
units.label: Point 28 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 29) exercise of the following types of municipal control in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on state control (supervision) and municipal control in the Russian Federation:
units.label: Point 29 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: а) municipal control over compliance by the single heat supply organization with obligations to construct, reconstruct and/or modernize heat supply facilities;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 29 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: б) municipal control in the field of territorial improvement and upkeep, whose subject is compliance with the municipality’s territorial improvement and upkeep rules, including requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of social, engineering and transport infrastructure facilities and services provided (in the course of municipal control in this field, an order may be issued to remedy violations of mandatory requirements identified through observation of compliance with mandatory requirements (safety monitoring);
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 29 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: в) municipal control in the field of protection and use of specially protected natural areas of local significance;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 29 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: г) municipal control over road transport, urban surface electric transport and road infrastructure within the boundaries of settlements forming part of the relevant municipality;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 29 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: д) municipal housing control;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 29 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: е) municipal land control within the municipality’s boundaries;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 29 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: ж) municipal forest control.
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 29 Part 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 3. To ensure the population’s daily life, a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for local self-government bodies to exercise the following powers:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 1) road-related activities concerning roads of local significance within the municipality’s boundaries and ensuring road traffic safety on them, including creating and ensuring the operation of parking facilities (parking spaces), organizing road traffic, and exercising other powers concerning road use and road-related activities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 2) creation of conditions for providing transport services to the population and organization of transport services for the population within the municipality’s boundaries;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 3) development and approval of programs for the integrated development of municipal utility infrastructure systems, transport infrastructure and social infrastructure, the requirements for which are established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 4) organization of environmental protection measures within the municipality’s boundaries, including organization and conduct, in accordance with environmental protection legislation, of public discussions of planned economic and other activities in the relevant municipality;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 5) approval and implementation of energy conservation and energy efficiency programs; organization of energy audits of apartment buildings whose premises form part of the municipal housing stock within the municipality’s boundaries; and organization and implementation of other measures provided for by legislation on energy conservation and energy efficiency;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 6) organization of funeral services;
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 7) participation in organizing the accumulation (including separate accumulation), collection, transportation, processing, recovery, neutralization and burial of municipal solid waste;
units.label: Point 7 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 8) development and approval of municipal master plans and land use and development rules; approval of territorial planning documentation; issue of an urban development plan for a land plot located within the municipality’s boundaries; issue of construction permits (except in the cases provided for by the Urban Development Code of the Russian Federation and other federal laws) and commissioning permits for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction facilities located in the municipality; approval of municipal local urban planning design standards; maintenance of an information system supporting urban development activities carried out in the municipality; decisions on reserving land and expropriating land plots within the municipality’s boundaries for municipal needs; inspections of buildings and structures in the cases provided for by the Urban Development Code of the Russian Federation and issue of recommendations to remedy violations identified during those inspections; sending notices that the parameters of an individual residential building or garden house specified in a notice of planned construction comply with the established parameters and that placement of the individual residential building or garden house on the land plot is permissible, notices that those parameters do not comply with the established parameters and/or that such placement is impermissible, and notices that a constructed or reconstructed individual residential building or garden house complies or does not comply with urban development legislation, where such buildings or houses are constructed or reconstructed on land plots in municipalities; decisions, in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation, to demolish an unauthorized structure, to demolish an unauthorized structure or bring it into compliance with established requirements, and to expropriate a land plot not used for its designated purpose or used in violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation; demolition of an unauthorized structure or bringing it into compliance with established requirements in the cases provided for by the Urban Development Code of the Russian Federation; decisions to declare a capital construction facility unsafe and subject to demolition or reconstruction in the cases provided for by that Code; and decisions on integrated territorial development and conclusion of integrated territorial development agreements in the cases provided for by that Code;
units.label: Point 8 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 9) decisions to change a land plot’s permitted use from one type to another, and decisions to transfer privately owned land plots from one land category to another, except in the cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 9 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 10) organization, in accordance with federal law, of comprehensive cadastral work and approval of the territory’s cadastral map-plan;
units.label: Point 10 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 11) decisions to establish or abolish forest districts and subordinate forest subdistricts located on settlement lands, and to establish and change their boundaries; and development and approval of forestry regulations for forest districts located on lands of settlements forming part of the municipality’s territory;
units.label: Point 11 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 12) implementation of forest management planning measures for forests located on lands of settlements forming part of the municipality’s territory;
units.label: Point 12 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 13) approval of the advertising structures placement plan, issue and cancellation of permits to install and operate advertising structures in the municipality, and issue of orders to dismantle advertising structures installed without authorization in the municipality, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on advertising;
units.label: Point 13 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 14) organization and implementation of territorial defense and civil defense measures and measures to protect the population and territory of the municipality from natural and technological emergencies, including maintaining public danger warning systems and civil defense facilities in constant readiness for use, and creating and maintaining stocks of equipment, food, medical and other supplies for civil defense purposes;
units.label: Point 14 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 15) establishment, maintenance and organization of the activities of emergency rescue services and/or emergency rescue units in the municipality;
units.label: Point 15 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 16) implementation of measures to ensure people’s safety at water bodies and protect their lives and health;
units.label: Point 16 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 17) establishment of rules for the use of public water bodies for personal and household needs, and informing the population of restrictions on the use of those water bodies, including ensuring citizens’ free access to public water bodies and their shore strips, and establishment of rules for the use of water bodies for recreational purposes;
units.label: Point 17 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 18) support for citizens and their associations participating in the protection of public order, and creation of conditions for the activities of voluntary public patrols.
units.label: Point 18 Part 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 4. The powers provided for in parts 2 and 3 of this Article are exercised taking into account the special provisions of this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 5. The powers provided for in part 2 of this Article may be redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by state authorities of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 6. The powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that are exercised by state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation following redistribution may not be transferred to local self-government bodies, even in part, through the procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers provided for in Article 34 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 7. The powers provided for in part 3 of this Article are redistributed by virtue of this Federal Law for exercise by state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. The powers provided for in part 3 of this Article may be redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 8. Redistribution by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article for exercise by local self-government bodies does not constitute vesting those bodies with individual state powers under Article 34 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 9. Redistribution by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the powers provided for in parts 2 and 3 of this Article is permitted for a period no shorter than the term of office of the legislative body of that constituent entity. Laws of a constituent entity providing for redistribution of powers enter into force at the beginning of the next financial year and must be adopted no later than two months before that year begins. Such laws may apply to all or to individual municipalities in the constituent entity and establish the scope of the powers redistributed by the law (including a list of individual components of a power where that power is not redistributed in full). If the powers redistributed by the law concern areas in which federal legislation provides for municipal control, the law on redistribution must contain provisions redistributing powers to exercise the corresponding type of municipal control. A law of the constituent entity redistributing the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article for exercise by local self-government bodies must contain provisions for transferring to those bodies the material resources and financial means necessary to exercise the powers.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 10. To ensure that state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation exercise the powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have been redistributed under part 5 of this Article and/or the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have not been redistributed by a law of that constituent entity for exercise by local self-government bodies, municipal property is made available for use without charge by the state authorities of the constituent entity under an agreement concluded between those authorities and local self-government bodies. The agreement determines the procedure for possession and use of the municipal property made available for use without charge by the state authorities of the constituent entity.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 11. The powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have not been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation are exercised by local self-government bodies. Exercise of those powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have not been redistributed is financed from the local budget.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 12. The powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation are exercised by state authorities of that constituent entity. Exercise of those powers provided for in part 2 of this Article that have been redistributed is financed from the budget of the constituent entity, without redistribution of revenues between that budget and the local budget.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 13. The powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have not been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies are exercised by state authorities of that constituent entity. Exercise of those powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have not been redistributed for exercise by local self-government bodies is financed from the budget of the constituent entity, without redistribution of revenues between that budget and the local budget.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 14. The powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies are exercised by local self-government bodies. Exercise of the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies is financed from the local budget, taking into account uniform, additional and/or differentiated shares of individual federal and/or regional taxes and fees, taxes under special tax regimes and non-tax revenues which, under the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and legislation on taxes and fees, are payable to the budget of the constituent entity, and/or interbudgetary transfers, mandatorily transferred by state authorities of the constituent entity to municipal budgets in accordance with the procedure established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation. When exercising the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity for exercise by local self-government bodies, those bodies may additionally use their own material resources and financial means in the cases and in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 15. If a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation redistributes the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article for exercise by local self-government bodies, state authorities of the constituent entity may oversee the exercise of those powers by local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 16. Local self-government bodies bear responsibility for exercising the powers provided for in part 3 of this Article that have been redistributed by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation for exercise by local self-government bodies, within the material resources and financial means transferred to those bodies in accordance with the law of the constituent entity provided for in part 5 of this Article.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 17. The powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life are established by parts 1–3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 18. The list of powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life may be changed only by amending and/or supplementing parts 1–3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 19. The powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life established by parts 1–3 of this Article may be specified in greater detail by federal laws to ensure their exercise. No new expenditure obligations not provided for by this Federal Law may thereby be imposed on municipalities.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 32
